Kennedy Jr.'s face, followed by a photo of him with two ravens on a railing, a photo of a whale breaching, a short, low-quality clip of an emu walking inside a house, a photo of RFK Jr. holding a dead bear cub, and a final photo of a dead raccoon on a road with a pixelated area on its body.
